sources.title: AI Deepfake Detector — Teamz Lab Tools
sources.snippet: When you upload a photo, the AI model analyzes pixel patterns, texture artifacts, and structural inconsistencies that are characteristic of AI-generated images. Real photographs have natural noise patterns and optical imperfections, while AI-generated images often contain subtle artifacts in hair, teeth, backgrounds, and symmetry.
